summary.one_liner: A replacement for the default macOS Console application, which the author finds broken since macOS 10.12 Sierra.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Console as a replacement for the built-in macOS Console log viewer. The author states that the default app has been unreliable since macOS 10.12 Sierra. The README does not list specific features, screenshots, or usage instructions. It also does not describe the implementation or how logs are read. The project is released under the MIT License.
use_cases: replace the broken default Console app
browse logs on macOS Sierra or later
notable: Alternative to Apple's built-in Console app, motivated by reported breakage since macOS 10.12 Sierra
caveats: README is brief and gives no installation, build, or usage instructions
Targets macOS; the README names no version support beyond the Sierra reference
